a happy proposal? no.

an unfounded proposal? thornier issue.

How will you classify a hacking tool and a diagnostic tool? Cain & Abel, nmap,... is used mainly as discovering what is running on your network but can also be used to see what is running on your targets network.

thats the issue. on one hand these things are as much war weapons, as all chemistry labs are WMD sites because you might make sarin gas in them. a ridiculous standard, because your only qualifying it as, what its made out of? and ignoring all the other benefits.

on the other hand, malware has already shut down a nuclear centrifuge, and will likely only get bigger capabilities as time continues.

logically, it would make more sense to decide it on what the thing does and the context of its use, but, we all know much logic gets followed.
